column1: # zipir comparison peers: one row per tool. Read by tools/common.sh and tools/report.py.
# format    corpus format the tool reads and writes (gzip, zlib, deflate, or bgzf).
# tier      prime (daily work), extended (wider check), all (publication runs). Selections nest.
# levels    compression levels on the tool's own scale: a range A-B or a space list; - is decode-only.
#           the three lane levels (--levels lanes, the default); - for decode-only tools. zipir,
#           zlib-ng, and the zlib-scale tools use 1/5/9. igzip 0/1/2 is its measured frontier.
#           deflate, and bgzf compressor lanes (added 2026-09-26) are provisional too: zlib-scale
#           1/5/9, libdeflate 1/6/12, and bgzip 1/5/9 on its own -l scale (with libdeflate, htslib
# decode    streaming or full-buffer. Reports never rank the two modes together.
#           gzip checks qualify.sh blocks on (yes); any other value records the result only.
# Every row is single-threaded. Versions live in tools/versions.sh.
